title: Replace faidx accessor leaves (faidx_nseq, faidx_iseq, faidx_seq_len64) with pure Rust
description: Replace 3 trivial faidx accessor FFI functions with pure Rust. faidx_nseq (4 lines, struct field access), faidx_iseq (4 lines, array index), faidx_seq_len64 (6 lines, HashMap lookup). All are leaves with no hts-sys dependencies. Used in src/faidx/mod.rs. Complexity: trivial.
